company_name: Osaka University,  Toyo Aluminium Research Laboratory of Semiconductors
semiconductor_relevance: High — Osaka University focuses on SiGe materials and devices, which are critical for semiconductor applications.
summary: Osaka University, through its Toyo Aluminium Research Laboratory of Semiconductors, specializes in SiGe materials and manufacturing technologies, bridging the gap between academia and industry. They develop SiGe-on-Insulator substrates and high-speed SiGe devices, including ultra-low-cost rectifiers using innovative fabrication techniques.
capabilities: Ultra-low-cost SiGe/Si rectifiers using screen printing and single-step annealing
technical_expertise: Defect reduction techniques in semiconductor materials
